thread:
elaine: Quick heads-up — experiment proposal: add a lightweight "micro-estimator" widget on the pricing page for the EU launch. Goal: reduce pricing friction for mid-market buyers.

mike: love it. what KPIs are we optimizing? CTR on CTA? trial starts? qualified leads?

elaine: primary: CTA clickthrough to trial (+10% target). secondary: lead form completion for sales (+5%). Tertiary: reduction in FAQ contact volume about "How much will this cost?"

nina: can we make the copy EU-friendly and use localized currency? also needs GDPR-friendly tracking (consent banner).

sam: +1 on localization. from eng side: we can surface USD/EUR/GBP and detect locale. needs one API flag and a small frontend component. ETA 3 days if we scope minimal.

kevin: For routing, prefer: micro-estimator -> inline lead form -> if ARR estimate > 50k, route to enterprise SDR queue; else route to self-serve onboarding flow. Is that okay?

elaine: yes. can we make the threshold configurable? want to test 25k vs 50k on week 1 A/B.

mike: recommend we A/B copy and button text too. Variant A: "Estimate my monthly cost". Variant B: "See your price". simple.

nina: propose adding one FAQ anchor below calculator: "How accurate is this estimate?" copy: "This is a ballpark estimate based on typical usage patterns. For exact pricing or committed discounts, contact sales."

sam: will add analytics events: microcalc_open, estimator_submit, estimator_threshold_hit, estimator_lead_submitted. need event naming sign-off.

kevin: signed off on events. pls also include utm+campaign tag = pricing_microflow_q2.

elaine: copy draft for the widget (short):
```
Find a price that fits your product
Quickly estimate monthly cost for your usage and team size. Enter tokens/month or pick a use-case.
[Estimate my monthly cost]
```

mike: tiny nit — change header to "Estimate your monthly cost" (makes it feel personal).

nina: localization note: German translation should avoid literal "kosten" in header — marketing will send variants.

marketing-bot: Reminder: Marketing calendar clash check — Webinar "Scaling Inference" on 2026-05-12. If estimator goes live before webinar, we can add a CTA in the webinar follow-up to drive trials.

elaine: excellent. timeline proposal: dev + analytics by 3 days, localization + legal check by EOD Fri, QA early next week, soft-launch to EU traffic Tuesday. Run 2-week A/B test.

sam: I'll open an eng ticket and tag @mike for front-end review.

kevin: sales routing config will be prepared in CRM, will need sample payload and field mapping.

mike: I'll draft the two copy variants and the small experiment spreadsheet (metrics + segments). will post later today.

elaine: thanks team. final asks: marketing to approve copy, legal to confirm privacy text snippet, eng to wire events, cs to prep FAQ answer. ping here when done. :rocket:
